headline: August SLC licenses: dozens of short-term rentals, Dollar Loan Center, Sweetgreen, Boeing
title: August 2026 New Business Licenses
why_it_matters: The list includes large blocks of short-term rental units: The Ritchie Group (20 units at 111 S 300 W), The Whitney (16 at 1481 S 400 W) and Journeyman Apartments (10 at 646 S 400 W). Chains include Dollar Loan Center (1768 S Redwood Rd), Sweetgreen (2188 S Highland Dr), Swig (451 S 1400 E), Cafe Rio and Apollo Burger (301 W South Temple St), 7-Eleven (1609 S 1100 E) and Maverik (414 W 500 S). Large employers include Amazon (620 S 5700 W), Boeing (1760 N 2200 W) and SkyWest Airlines (1220 N and 1440 N 2200 W).

headline: SLC September licenses: Magnolia Bakery, airport eateries, tattoo shops, short-term rentals
title: September 2026 New Business Licenses
why_it_matters: Of 217 new licenses, notable ones include Magnolia Bakery at Foothill Village (1400 S Foothill Dr), airport outlets Swig, Einstein Bros Bagels, Moochie's, Mr. Charlie's Chicken Fingers and Monarca (3920 W Terminal Dr), and Marmalade Brunch House (535 N 300 W). Tattoo shops Angel Baby Tattoo and Dreaded Designs (1435 S State St), Ink by KP (1816 S State St) and JustInk (2121 S McClelland St) also applied. Short-term rental licenses cluster at 1590 S 900 W, 340 W 700 S (Roers Granary), 163 W 200 S and 320 N 490 W. Other names include Maverik, Columbia Bank, Yamaha Motor and Hyve Virtual Motorsports.
